## Chapter 1 — String Matching

1. [**Naive String Matching**](notebooks/01-naive.qmd) — Step through every alignment of P against T
2. [**KMP**](notebooks/02-kmp.qmd) — Failure function (sp values) and search with fallback arrows
   — [KMP visualizer →](visualizers/kmp.html){target="_blank"}
3. [**Z-Algorithm**](notebooks/03-z-algorithm.qmd) — Z-array computation with Z-box reuse
4. [**Boyer-Moore**](notebooks/04-boyer-moore.qmd) — Right-to-left scanning with bad character rule
5. [**Suffix Trie & Suffix Tree**](notebooks/05-suffix-structures.qmd) — Build and visualize suffix structures
6. [**Algorithm Comparison**](notebooks/06-algorithm-comparison.qmd) — Side-by-side character comparison counts
7. [**Keyword Tree**](notebooks/07-keyword-tree.qmd) — Multiple pattern matching: tree builder and search visualization
8. [**Shift-And**](notebooks/08-shift-and.qmd) — Bit-parallel matching: alphabet masks, DP matrix, and bit-vector operations
